phase: V4-D2 novelty / anti-rescue audit of six blind proposals

measurement_protocol.scope: feature-space only: ranking-signal cross-sections at sample decision dates; NO PnL, NO backtest, NO arm scoring; read-only on the staged snapshot
measurement_protocol.sample_date_rule: every 126th SPY session inside S0 (2018-04-04..2025-07-31), PIT trailing windows only; 10 names before XLC 252-session eligibility, 11 after

reference_rankings.REF-MOM: plain 12-1 cross-sectional momentum: adj close(t-21)/adj close(t-252) - 1 (family-a proxy, long = past winner)
reference_rankings.REF-VOL: plain close-to-close realized volatility: RMS daily adj return over trailing 252 sessions (vol-level reference)

long_direction_scores.a4_h1: +semivariance share S126 (long high downside share, per anchor)
long_direction_scores.a5_h2: +shock if follow21 <= per-date median else -shock (long unconfirmed/high-shock, short confirmed/high-shock, per anchor)
long_direction_scores.a6_h2: -overnight variance share 63 (long low on-share, per anchor)

measurement_protocol.flag_rule: per controller instruction: |Spearman rho| >= 0.9 vs a forbidden reference ranking on sampled dates -> HIGH flag
measurement_protocol.statistics: per-date Spearman on the 10-11 name cross-section, plus pooled Spearman over all date x sector observations; descriptive, no inference claimed at n=10-11

reference_entanglement.note: the two forbidden references are near-orthogonal across sample dates in this universe (sign flips with regime: +0.60..+0.81 in 2018/2021 up-legs, -0.35..-0.62 in 2020/2022 stress), so measured correlations against each reference are interpretable separately

a4_h1.title: semivariance-share (downside/total second moment, 126s) cross-sectional spread on 11 sector ETFs, long high-S / short low-S, hysteresis book, 21s clock

forbidden_family_descent.a_sector_momentum_and_inversions: OUTSIDE, with partial co-movement: long-high-S tends to hold recent losers in trending regimes; measured
forbidden_family_descent.b_trend_sma200_vol_target: OUTSIDE - sign-blind squared-return state, market-neutral fixed-gross book, no SMA/trend/vol-target input anywhere
forbidden_family_descent.c_idio_shock_reversal: OUTSIDE - persistent 126-session state with hysteresis, no event-conditioned fade; explicitly disclaimed in source_to_test_map item 3
forbidden_family_descent.d_calendars: OUTSIDE - session-count 21s clock, no date claim
forbidden_family_descent.e_rescue_tweak: OUTSIDE - new mechanism and state variable; not an inversion/fee/subset/lookback tweak of any dead family

measured_evidence.interpretation: shape axis is measured orthogonal to the vol level (rho ~ 0), so the level-sort control is informative; the momentum-inversion co-movement is real but crosses 0.9 on 1/15 dates only; long-basket Jaccard 0.21 across 6-month steps shows ranks churn - not a static sector bet

a4_h1.trend_reducibility: NONE - score is built from squared returns and a sign indicator, invariant to the direction of past returns; no rule path reduces it to a long/short trend condition
a4_h1.control_meaningfulness: STRONG - variance-LEVEL control shares full surface form (same book/clock/fills) but measured ranking correlation with the anchor score is ~0 (mean rho -0.02), so it plausibly does not carry the shape mechanism; preregistered falsification rule is concrete and numeric (|ctrl incremental alpha| < 0.5 x anchor alpha AND ctrl expectancy <= 0, frozen gate control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt = 0.5)
a4_h1.parameter_menu: NONE - single fixed rule (126s window, 21s clock, 4/4 bands <=4/>=8, 0.25 weights); one preregistered 63s neighbour; explicit no-alternatives clause
a4_h1.novelty_vs_crypto_ancestry: NOVEL - no entry in crypto_ancestry_for_novelty_only resembles a semivariance-share/skewness cross-sectional spread
a4_h1.result_level_hazards: LOW - book is net ~0 by construction (4x+0.25 / 4x-0.25); kappa_t clip(beta_hat,0,2) risk-match and [SPY, EW_SECTOR] OLS intercept both preregistered; fail-closed stated; 8/11 legs held keeps concentration low; incremental-alpha test is identifiable

findings.evidence: rho(score, 12-1 momentum) mean -0.462 over 15 dates, 4/15 dates |rho| >= 0.8, worst -0.927 (2019-10-03)
findings.implication: in trending regimes the long-high-S basket overlaps a bottom-momentum (inverted family-a) book; below the 0.9 HIGH bar on the sample as a whole, so not a renamed inversion, but the mechanism test must not be read as fully orthogonal to the dead momentum axis

a4_h1.one_line: Genuinely new shape-vs-level mechanism with an orthogonal, informative control; MEDIUM flag for partial inverted-momentum co-movement (mean rho -0.46, 1/15 dates >= 0.9).

a4_h2.title: volatility-of-volatility (stdev of 12x21s block vols, 252s) cross-sectional spread, long low-vov / short high-vov, market-neutral hysteresis book

forbidden_family_descent.a_sector_momentum_and_inversions: OUTSIDE - measured rho vs 12-1 momentum mean -0.064 (clean)
forbidden_family_descent.b_trend_sma200_vol_target: OUTSIDE structurally (no targeting, no trend filter, market-neutral spread) but see HIGH identification finding: the ranking axis is measured near-identical to the inverted vol-LEVEL ranking, the raw material of the vol-managed/defensive family
forbidden_family_descent.c_idio_shock_reversal: OUTSIDE - persistent state, no event conditioning
forbidden_family_descent.e_rescue_tweak: OUTSIDE - new state variable, not a tweak of a dead family

measured_evidence.interpretation: on every one of the 15 sampled dates the long-low-vov book is a long-low-vol-LEVEL book (all per-date rhos negative, mean -0.79); the long basket is semi-static (Jaccard 0.54, defensives persist)

a4_h2.trend_reducibility: NONE - sign-blind second-moment statistic; no directional persistence encoded
a4_h2.control_meaningfulness: WEAK-BY-COLLINEARITY - the preregistered realized-vol LEVEL control is the right control in form and its numeric rule is concrete (|ctrl alpha| < 0.5 x anchor alpha AND ctrl expectancy <= 0), but the measured 0.79-0.93 rank identity between anchor score and control variable means the control structurally subsumes the anchor: expected outcome is control firing and anchor self-rejection even if a small vov-specific effect exists; identification of 'uncertainty about risk' from 'risk level' is weak at 11-name scale
a4_h2.parameter_menu: NONE - single fixed rule (12x21 blocks, 252s, 3/3 bands <=3/>=9, 0.20 weights); one preregistered 6x21/126s neighbour
a4_h2.novelty_vs_crypto_ancestry: NOVEL with note - name-adjacent to H-VOLCOMP-BRKOUT-v1 (vol-compression breakout) but vov dispersion-of-the-risk-path is a different statistic and trade; informational only
a4_h2.result_level_hazards: LOW - gross 1.2 net ~0 book, kappa risk-match + sector OLS preregistered; identifiable

findings.evidence: rho(-vov, realized vol 252) mean -0.792, range -0.609..-0.927, 8/15 dates |rho| >= 0.8, 4/15 >= 0.9, all 15 negative
findings.implication: the anchor's claimed novelty axis is not separable from the vol level in this cross-section; the preregistered 0.5-ratio control gate will very likely fire, i.e. the design is expected to self-reject; selection committee should carry a strong prior against survival, but this is identification weakness, not forbidden descent

findings.evidence: long-basket consecutive Jaccard 0.543 (semi-static defensive long side)
findings.implication: residual static sector-ordering exposure of the kind that let the V2 A4 family's controls reproduce via sector beta; the preregistered [SPY, EW_SECTOR] intercept mitigates

a4_h2.one_line: Not a forbidden descent and anti-rescue-safe, but measured 0.79-0.93 rank identity between the vov anchor and the inverted vol-level control means the causal control structurally subsumes the anchor - expect self-rejection.

a5_h1.title: dollar-volume participation shock (21s mean / 231s prior mean, raw path) cross-sectional spread, long top-3 / short bottom-3 shock, quarterly 63s cadence

forbidden_family_descent.a_sector_momentum_and_inversions: OUTSIDE - measured rho vs 12-1 momentum mean +0.394, max 0.745, 0/15 dates >= 0.8; volume-chases-winners flavor only
forbidden_family_descent.b_trend_sma200_vol_target: OUTSIDE - ranking contains no price-return term (verified: score vs realized vol rho mean -0.03); dollar-neutral fixed-gross book
forbidden_family_descent.c_idio_shock_reversal: OUTSIDE - long high-participation continuation claim, no shock fade
forbidden_family_descent.d_calendars: OUTSIDE - session-count 63s cadence; no turn-of-month/settlement/mid-month dependence anywhere in the rule
forbidden_family_descent.e_rescue_tweak: OUTSIDE - the dead SFV3-A6 family was calendar concentration; this is a participation-state mechanism with no date claim

measured_evidence.interpretation: participation-shock ranks are only moderately momentum-adjacent and uncorrelated with vol level; the one-quarter-stale control is measured non-collinear with the anchor (rho 0.29), so the causal control discriminates rather than mirrors

a5_h1.trend_reducibility: NONE - ranking feature is a pure volume ratio (raw close x volume); no price level, return, sign or trend term enters the rule; the mechanism predicts continuation but the rule cannot be reduced to a trend condition
a5_h1.control_meaningfulness: STRONG - stale-participation control shares full surface form but shifts the feature one holding period; measured rank correlation anchor-vs-stale 0.289 means it plausibly lacks the contemporaneous-shock ingredient; preregistered numeric rule present (refute if ctrl expectancy > 0 AND |ctrl alpha| >= 0.5 x anchor alpha)
a5_h1.parameter_menu: NONE - single fixed rule (21/231 windows, 63s cadence, 3v3 at 1/6, alphabetical ties); one preregistered 63s-numerator neighbour; adverse-turnover outcome preregistered as a falsification surface, not a tuning target
a5_h1.novelty_vs_crypto_ancestry: NOVEL - Gervais-class volume-shock premium at sector-ETF granularity; no crypto ancestor covers it; informational adjacency to flow families only
a5_h1.result_level_hazards: LOW - 3v3 dollar-neutral gross 1.0 net 0.0; frozen ex-ante risk-match scale 0.5 declared; SPY + EW-sector OLS with explicit 'materially nonzero realized beta is a design-failure flag'; raw PnL never accepted as alpha; feature uses raw _none path so split-contamination of DV is avoided within S0 (declared splits are post-S0)

findings.implication: in high-volume episodes the long side leans toward past winners; well below the flag bar and mechanically expected (volume chases performance)

findings.evidence: 30 decision slots across S0 with zero slack (proposal's own statement); PF computed over 30 decision PnLs
findings.implication: power, not novelty; noted for A9-F/selection

a5_h1.one_line: Cleanest of the six: volume-only axis measured near-orthogonal to both forbidden references, and the stale-rank control is measured non-collinear (rho 0.29) so it genuinely discriminates.

a5_h2.title: participation-quality interaction: long top-shock/unconfirmed (small |21s move|), short top-shock/confirmed (large |21s move|), quarterly dollar-neutral book

forbidden_family_descent.a_sector_momentum_and_inversions: OUTSIDE as a signed-momentum inversion - the follow-through axis is |return| magnitude, sign-blind; measured: quietness axis vs signed 21s momentum rho mean 0.053; anchor score vs 12-1 momentum mean +0.266; short basket overlaps top-3 momentum sectors by 1.07/3 legs on average
forbidden_family_descent.b_trend_sma200_vol_target: OUTSIDE - no trend filter, fixed gross
forbidden_family_descent.c_idio_shock_reversal: ADJACENT, MEDIUM - the short leg fades large recent price moves among high-participation sectors: a volume-conditioned magnitude-fade, structurally adjacent to the overshoot-fade axis of the dead SFV3-A5 family, but it is a persistent cross-sectional tilt, not an event-conditioned shock countertrade, and it is long-biased within its own event (absorption) rather than short-the-shock

measured_evidence.interpretation: the anchor is 0.60-0.89 rank-identical to its own price-only quietness control on every sampled date: the volume screen is a minority axis, so the preregistered control will very likely reproduce the anchor and fire the 0.5-ratio gate; signed-momentum descent is excluded by measurement

a5_h2.trend_reducibility: NONE as a directional trend rule (uses |return| magnitude and a volume ratio); PARTIAL collapse risk to the quietness book if the shock ranking is weakly informative across sectors - measured collapse is substantial (rho 0.775)
a5_h2.control_meaningfulness: GOOD-IN-PRINCIPLE, expected-to-fire - the price-only quietness control is exactly the right anti-rescue device (it catches a price-shock artifact and the proposal preregisters rejection if it reproduces), the rule is numeric (ctrl expectancy > 0 AND |ctrl alpha| >= 0.5 x anchor alpha); but measured anchor-control rank identity 0.775 means the control subsumes most of the anchor's composition, so the design has little room to pass for the claimed interaction reason
a5_h2.parameter_menu: NONE - single fixed rule (21s shock windows, 21s follow, deterministic median split with tie to unconfirmed, deterministic n-versus-n completion); one preregistered 42s-follow neighbour
a5_h2.novelty_vs_crypto_ancestry: NOVEL with note - absorption/crowding narrative is informationally adjacent to H-FUNDCROWD-MR-v2 and the V10 M01 aggressor-absorption panel, but those used funding/order-flow data absent here; daily-OHLCV interaction is a different object
a5_h2.result_level_hazards: LOW - 3v3 (or n-v-n) dollar-neutral, frozen 0.5 risk-match scale, SPY + EW-sector OLS, nonzero-beta design-failure flag, no-volume mutation test required for the control - identifiable

findings.evidence: anchor-vs-quietness-control rank rho mean 0.775 (range 0.60-0.891, positive on all 15 dates, 6/15 >= 0.8)
findings.implication: volume conditioning is a minority axis of the book; the preregistered control is expected to reproduce the anchor and fire the gate - the design is anti-rescue-safe but has weak identification of the claimed interaction; carry a strong prior against survival

findings.evidence: short leg = top-shock/confirmed = large |21s move| among high-participation sectors; overlap with top-3 signed-momentum sectors 1.07/3 legs average, 2+ legs on 5/15 dates (per-date overlap counts: 2018-04:1, 2018-10:3, 2019-04:2, 2019-10:1, 2020-04:0, 2020-10:0, 2021-04:2, 2021-10:0, 2022-04:3, 2022-10:0, 2023-04:1, 2023-10:0, 2024-04:1, 2024-10:2, 2025-04:0)
findings.implication: in trending windows the short side approximates fading recent movers, the neighborhood of the dead overshoot-reversal family; sign-blind |return| construction and volume conditioning keep it outside, but a pass must be attributed to the interaction, not to the fade axis

a5_h2.one_line: Not a signed-momentum or shock-reversal rename (measured), but the anchor is 0.78 rank-identical to its own quietness control - the volume interaction is a minority axis and the preregistered control is expected to fire.

a6_h1.title: Garman-Klass 63s range-variance cross-sectional spread, long 3 lowest / short 3 highest, SPY-beta-hedged (252s OLS, hedge truncated +/-0.25), 42s cadence

forbidden_family_descent.a_sector_momentum_and_inversions: OUTSIDE - measured rho vs 12-1 momentum mean +0.045, 0/15 dates >= 0.8; sign-blind range statistic
forbidden_family_descent.b_trend_sma200_vol_target: OUTSIDE as a rule (no trend filter, frozen gross, never de-risks) - but the ranking variable is a VOLATILITY LEVEL, the raw material of the vol-managed family; see HIGH redundancy finding
forbidden_family_descent.c_idio_shock_reversal: OUTSIDE - persistent state, no event conditioning, 42s holding of a cross-sectional tilt
forbidden_family_descent.e_rescue_tweak: OUTSIDE - no dead family used a cross-sectional vol-level spread; this is a new (to the program) pricing question, not a tweak

score_vs_same_window_cc63_variance.note: identity with SFV4-A6-H2's preregistered close-to-close variance CONTROL ranking

measured_evidence.interpretation: the GK ranking IS a vol-level ranking: 0.83 mean rank correlation with plain 252s realized vol, crossing 0.9 on 7/15 sampled dates (including a perfect -1.000), and 0.86 identical to the same-window close-to-close variance ranking that H2 preregisters as its negative control; the claimed 5-7.4x estimator efficiency contributes no visible ranking information; long basket is near-static (Jaccard 0.69) - a standing long-defensive/short-cyclical tilt, the exact static-sector-ordering surface on which the V2 A4 family's controls reproduced via sector beta

a6_h1.trend_reducibility: NONE - range-variance is sign-blind; gross is a frozen constant and the arm never scales exposure; no SMA/trend path
a6_h1.control_meaningfulness: WEAK - the alphabetical-ticker control shares surface form but is inert by construction: it can detect surface-form-only alpha yet cannot discriminate the claimed mechanism (range estimator) from the obvious rival (plain vol level), because measured GK ranks and CC-vol ranks are 0.86-identical; there is NO preregistered control that isolates the estimator from the vol level; preregistered numeric rule exists (|alpha_ctrl| >= 0.5 x |alpha_anchor| or ctrl expectancy > 0 with PF >= 1.0) but it tests book shape, not mechanism
a6_h1.parameter_menu: NONE - single estimator, single 63s window, single 42s holding, single 252s beta window, 3+3 at 1/6, hedge truncation [-0.25,+0.25]; one preregistered Parkinson neighbour - which, given the measured GK/CC redundancy, is an estimator-swap within an already-redundant family
a6_h1.novelty_vs_crypto_ancestry: NOVEL as a pricing question (BAB/low-vol cross-sectional premium on sector ETFs is new to the stocks program) but the OPERATIONALIZATION is redundant: the measured ranking is the plain vol-level ranking, so the test reduces to a plain low-vol-minus-high-vol sector spread
a6_h1.result_level_hazards: LOW-to-MEDIUM - beta hedge truncated at +/-0.25 with measured typical need ~0.25-0.30 leaves residual net beta up to ~0.05-0.10, which works AGAINST a long-defensive book in the S0 bull sample (fail-safe direction); declared ZERO SPY-context multiple keeps the incremental-alpha test identifiable; EW-sector residual honestly demoted to diagnostic; the real exposure hazard is static sector-ordering risk (Jaccard 0.69), not hidden beta

findings.evidence: rho(-GK63, realized vol 252) mean -0.826, 7/15 dates |rho| >= 0.9 (min -1.000 at 2022-04-04); rho(-GK63, -CC63) mean 0.858
findings.implication: triggered by the controller's >= 0.9 measurement rule against the realized-vol reference: the estimator-efficiency novelty is not visible in ranking space and the arm is operationally a plain close-to-close low-vol/high-vol sector spread; eligibility is retained because a cross-sectional vol-level spread is not an entry in (nor a rename/inversion of) the forbidden families, but the proposal's central causal novelty claim is contradicted by measurement

findings.evidence: A6-H1 anchor ranking vs A6-H2 preregistered control ranking: mean rho 0.858 (min 0.661)
findings.implication: H1's anchor and H2's control are the same book family; if H1 passes, H2's 0.5-ratio control gate fires almost mechanically (and H2's failure would then be attributable to H1's premium, not to H2's mechanism); A1 must not score or select these as independent evidence - at most one of the pair can carry identification

findings.evidence: long-basket consecutive Jaccard 0.693; defensive sectors persistently lowest range-vol
findings.implication: the book approximates a standing long-defensive/short-growth bet - the surface on which V2's momentum anchor was shown to be sector-beta; drop-one-ETF will not remove a persistent ordering, only fold gates can

findings.evidence: causal_negative_control is alphabetical-ticker order; no GK-vs-CC-vol control exists in the design
findings.implication: even a pass could not attribute the premium to range-based efficiency rather than to the plain vol level; the neighbour (Parkinson) partially covers estimator family but is same-axis, not a rival-mechanism control

a6_h1.one_line: Measured HIGH: GK ranks are 0.83-1.00 the plain realized-vol ranks (>= 0.9 on 7/15 dates) and 0.86 identical to A6-H2's preregistered control - estimator novelty is contradicted by measurement and the pair is selection-contaminated; not a forbidden descent, so eligible with heavy discount.

a6_h2.title: overnight variance share (V_on/(V_on+V_intra), 63s, adjusted path) cross-sectional spread, long 3 lowest / short 3 highest, SPY-beta-hedged, 42s cadence

forbidden_family_descent.a_sector_momentum_and_inversions: OUTSIDE - measured rho vs 12-1 momentum mean -0.095 with sign flips across regimes; squared-return sign-blind statistic
forbidden_family_descent.b_trend_sma200_vol_target: OUTSIDE - frozen gross, no trend filter, no targeting; partial vol-level overlap is measured and disclosed below
forbidden_family_descent.c_idio_shock_reversal: OUTSIDE - explicitly not a gap-fade: no gap size, direction or event conditioning enters the key; persistent state held 42s with a beta hedge; the 'fade the gap' resemblance is disclaimed and the disclaimer is verified by construction
forbidden_family_descent.d_calendars: OUTSIDE - the overnight/intraday split is a market-structure decomposition applied identically to every session, not a date-selection or settlement-window claim; no return attaches to specific dates
forbidden_family_descent.e_rescue_tweak: OUTSIDE - new decomposition, not a tweak of any dead family

measured_evidence.interpretation: overnight-share is a genuinely distinct axis from both references (never crosses 0.9 vs either), while remaining moderately correlated with the vol level (mean -0.55) and with its own CC-variance control (0.57) - enough overlap that the control is informative but not pre-determined

a6_h2.trend_reducibility: NONE - squared overnight/intraday returns only; no direction, no SMA, no exposure scaling
a6_h2.control_meaningfulness: GOOD - close-to-close variance-level control shares the exact surface form (long-low-risk-stat/short-high-risk-stat) but plausibly lacks the WHERE-variance-arrives mechanism; measured rank overlap 0.566 means it correlates without subsuming; preregistered numeric rule concrete (reject if |alpha_ctrl| >= 0.5 x |alpha_anchor| or ctrl expectancy > 0 with PF >= 1.0); the design also preregisters the informative joint outcome (control fires + anchor fails => variance-level premium belongs to H1's class)
a6_h2.parameter_menu: NONE - single statistic, 63s window, 42s holding, 252s beta, 3+3 at 1/6, hedge [-0.25,+0.25], 1e-12 denominator guard declared frozen; one preregistered 21s-window neighbour
a6_h2.novelty_vs_crypto_ancestry: NOVEL - the Lou-Polk-Skouras clientele decomposition has no entry in the crypto ancestry list; informational adjacency to overnight-accrual carry flavor only
a6_h2.result_level_hazards: LOW - same hedge-truncation residual as H1 (fail-safe direction), zero SPY-context multiple, EW-sector residual honestly demoted; adjusted-open fallback declared ex ante; identifiable

findings.evidence: rho(-onshare63, realized vol 252) mean -0.548 (2/15 dates >= 0.8, 0/15 >= 0.9); rho vs own CC63 control 0.566
findings.implication: a fifth or so of the ranking axis is vol level; the preregistered control covers this confound with a numeric gate, so the residual identification risk is bounded and disclosed

findings.evidence: its preregistered control is 0.858 rank-identical to A6-H1's anchor
findings.implication: if A6-H1 is also selected/scored, H2's control gate outcome is entangled with H1's result; score and interpret the pair jointly, never as independent confirmations

a6_h2.one_line: Genuinely new decomposition axis (never crosses 0.9 vs either forbidden reference), honest and numeric control; MEDIUM flags for partial vol-level overlap and pair-contamination with A6-H1's anchor.

overall_summary.ineligible_reason: no proposal is inside a forbidden entry or a renamed/inverted descendant of one: none ranks on sector relative strength or 12-1 momentum (measured: all |rho| vs REF-MOM <= 0.75 mean, none >= 0.9 except single-date excursions), none encodes a time-series trend/SMA/vol-target rule, none is an event-conditioned shock fade, none uses a calendar, and none is an inversion/fee/subset/lookback tweak of a dead family
overall_summary.high_severity_pattern: the dominant measured risk is not descent but CONTROL IDENTITY: on this 11-name cross-section, A4-H2's vov anchor is 0.79 rank-identical to its vol-level control, A5-H2's anchor is 0.78 rank-identical to its quietness control, and A6-H1's GK anchor is 0.86 rank-identical to A6-H2's variance-level control. After two cycles in which controls reproduced the mechanisms, the measured prediction is that A4-H2, A5-H2 and (via the pair entanglement) A6-H1 will again be rejected BY THEIR OWN CONTROLS; A6-H1 additionally has no estimator-discriminating control, so its novelty claim cannot be isolated even by a pass
strongest_candidates_by_novelty: SFV4-A5-H1 (volume-only axis, measured near-orthogonal to both forbidden references, non-collinear stale control)
SFV4-A6-H2 (overnight-share axis, never crosses 0.9 vs either reference, informative control)
SFV4-A4-H1 (shape-vs-level axis measured orthogonal to vol level; medium momentum-inversion co-movement to watch)
notes_for_a1_selection: Treat SFV4-A6-H1 and SFV4-A6-H2 as ONE entangled pair: H1's anchor is H2's control family (rho 0.858); at most one carries identification, and a joint pass/fail pattern must be interpreted jointly, not as two independent tests.

A4-H2 and A5-H2 should be carried only if A1 accepts high prior probability of control-gate self-rejection; their passing would require the minority orthogonal axis (21-22% of rank content) to carry more than twice the alpha of the shared axis.

No proposal has a net-long unhedged book; all six preregister ex-ante risk-match rules and sector-factor steps, so the incremental-alpha test is identifiable in all six; residual hedge-truncation beta in A6 arms is small and fail-safe in direction.
No parameter menus, grids or best-of structures found in any proposal; each has exactly one preregistered neighbour, which is contract-compliant mechanism support, not a menu.
The 0.9-momentum flag is crossed on isolated dates only by A4-H1 (1/15) and A4-H2's vov (0/15); no proposal's ranking is a wholesale momentum rename by measurement.
overall_summary.historical_denominator_note: this audit computes no scored PnL and increments no counters; findings are feature-space measurements on the staged snapshot only

attestation: A7-N read only the six proposal files, the forbidden packet, run contract, baseline invariants and the staged snapshot; computed feature-space statistics only (no PnL, no backtest, no arm scoring, no S1 access); made no edits to any proposal file; verdicts are eligibility judgements on forbidden-family descent and anti-rescue structure, with severities conveying measured identification risk for the selection freeze.
